## Why

Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-021106-86c7 for S261 (discovered from S261):

matrix copy: ask each project's question right after that project's preview
- `roles.go:164-186` prints every project's preview first and asks all the questions afterwards. With `--all` and a real 26-row source, each project can have dozens of step lines, so a project's steps and warnings scroll out of view before its `[y/N]` question. The `copy-ask` render (lines 2-22) shows the gap even with two projects of 8 steps each.
- Change: print a project's block, then ask its question. The single write call stays the same. `docs/design.md:4172-4175` and the test at `roles_matrix_test.go:200` would need updating.

## Implement

Print each project preview immediately before its question, retaining one write call. Label the write result with written: and omit repeated steps and warnings for changed projects. Wrap failure and skipped status lines at 80 columns with a two-space hang; omit the redundant project name in no_spec_check_row. Add MatrixCopyStep fields derived from ork plan.set(): only values different from the current target row, printed as key=value in order role, when, agent, vendor, model, reasoning, note (owner decision 2026-11-25, ui.matrix-copy-step-fields). Give differing add ids a named refusal code, comma-separated ids, no-write statement and preview-again hint. Include planned rule text in the per-project digest. Add selectable matrix-copy preview, question and stale-preview CLI render fixtures. Update docs and the slice changelog entry.
